html: New preprint: "Physical Agentic AI: An Architecture for Orchestrating a Robot Crew with LLMs", with a real Unitree G1 humanoid and Go2 quadruped. An abridged version appears at the IROS'26 Workshop on Foundation Models in Multi-Robot Systems.
Our paper "CUPID in the Model Zoo: Online Matchmaking for Selecting Your Dream LLM" was accepted to ICML'26.
Two workshop papers at ICLR'26: "LLM Routing as Reasoning: A MaxSAT View" and "Cognitive Models as Evaluation Primitives in Humanoid Factors".
New preprint: "Humanoid Factors: Design Principles for AI Humanoids in Human Worlds".
Our paper "Neural-Augmented Kelvinlet for Real-Time Soft Tissue Deformation Modeling" was accepted to AAAI'26.
Joined Arizona State University as a PhD student in Computer Science, in the LENS Lab.
